⚠️ Danger Zone — Wipe All Data

This clears all student activity currently on the CMG Server. Specifically:

  • Every submitted result on the CMG Server is deleted.
  • Every student's name, school, score, badge, and photo on the CMG Server is cleared — but the activation codes themselves (the ones printed on your pendrive labels) are kept, so students can activate fresh with the same codes.

This cannot be undone. The Questions bank and Notifications are not touched.
